newsitem.title: USA: Tyco Int'l stake cut by Westar Capital.
newsitem.headline: Tyco Int'l stake cut by Westar Capital.

text.p: Westar Capital Inc said Tuesday it has reduced its stake in Tyco International Ltd to 6.5 percent or 15,883,535 shares by selling more than 2.5 million shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the Topeka, Kan., investor said it sold the 2,545,200 shares in open market transactions between July 9 and July 21 at $78 to $80.19 each.
Westar said in the SEC filing that it sold the shares in order to obtain what it considered to be "favorable market prices."
On July 2, Tyco said it completed its $5.4 bilion merger deal with ADT Ltd, with Tyco being the surviving company.

In keeping with the terms of the agreement, Tyco shareholders received one share of the combined company for each share of Tyco stock held. ADT shareholders received 0.41822 share of the combined company for each ADT share.
The combined companies make fire and security alarms in Europe and the United States.
